Demutualization of the Colombo
Stock  Exchange

16.
The Board of Directors of the Demutualized Stock

Exchange  shall 
take  necessary  action 
to 
list 
the
Demutualized  Stock  Exchange  on  its  own  exchange  with
the  approval  of  the  Commission  within  a  period  of  three
years from the date of conversion unless otherwise specified
in writing by the Commission.

17.
(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the
Companies  Act,  No.  7  of  2007,  the  Demutualized  Stock
Exchange  shall  not  make  payment  of  a  dividend  to  its
hareholders or a further issue of shares prior to listing of the
Demutualized Stock Exchange.
(2)  Notwithstanding  anything  to  the  contrary  in  the
Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007, any benefit other than voting
rights that accrues to shareholders as a result of a payment of
dividends or a further issue of shares after listing, shall be
paid or allocated as the case may be by the Demutualized
Stock Exchange, in respect of shares allocated and not issued
in terms of section 6.
(3) The Demutualized Stock Exchange shall not lend or
borrow other than in the ordinary course of business or as
otherwise approved by the Commission prior to listing.
